Date: 12 January 2025
Exam: Multiparametric MRI prostate
Clinical indication: PSA 4.5 ng/mL, prior biopsy Gleason 3+4. Evaluate for focal lesion.

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume: 56.09 mL. PSA density 0.08 ng/mL/mL.
T2-weighted images show a focal hypointense lesion in the right apical transition zone, measuring approximately 14 mm in greatest dimension.
Diffusion-weighted imaging demonstrates marked restricted diffusion in this region, with corresponding low ADC values.
Dynamic contrast-enhanced sequences reveal early, intense enhancement of the same lesion.
No evidence of extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion. Clinical T stage cT1c.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 4 lesion in the right apical transition zone.
cT1c.

previous_notes.text: Patient attended for routine follow-up. PSA measured at 4.2 ng/mL, showing a slight rise from the previous value of 3.7 ng/mL recorded in September 2023. Discussed the stable PSA trend and current medication list. Referred to urology for re-evaluation given the prior biopsy diagnosis of prostate cancer and the need to discuss long-term management options.
